title: Landing fixture test races Git's detached auto-maintenance on the victim repository
outcome: Landing fixture test races Git's detached auto-maintenance on the victim repository
acceptance: The doctor landing test fixtures run Git with automatic maintenance disabled (`-c maintenance.auto=false` in fixture_git_command), so a fixture `git commit` starts no detached `git maintenance run --auto`, and fixture_commands_ignore_inherited_repository_routing compares victim snapshots that no background Git process can change
The landing tests pass in the full gate

completion.summary:
Fixed the GitHub CI flake Greg reported in fixture_commands_ignore_inherited_repository_routing. On Unix, a commit made with recent Git starts detached auto-maintenance, which held objects/maintenance.lock while the test snapshotted the victim repository. fixture_git_command now passes `-c maintenance.auto=false`, and a new test pins that option structurally.
- Round 2: the full gate test-ae35778b passed 9/9, and the Codex+Claude pair was clean.
- The round-1 gate failure (MCP close under host load) is classified and filed as w-9b4c461113c7. The other fixture helpers are filed as w-7ccecfeaa483.
- Evaluation f5c9ccea passed 2/2. Landed as ed50f19 and installed as build 03bab16541c5.
